competitors.name: Kraft Heinz
competitors.action: Food Dive reported Kraft Heinz is extending core brands around unmet dietary needs, including lactose-free Philadelphia cream cheese, gluten-free Velveeta Shells & Cheese, plant-based Kraft Mac & Cheese, extra-protein Kraft Mac & Cheese, no-artificial-color Jell-O and clean-label Heinz Simply. Management said the strategy is to use trusted existing brands rather than build new brands for these need states.

competitors.name: Mondelēz / Tate's Bake Shop
competitors.action: Food Dive reported Mondelēz is using Tate's Bake Shop as a premium growth platform. Tate's has roughly 2% of the $11.2B sweet cookie market, grew 2.5x faster than the category in 2025, and may expand beyond cookies into bake-shop-style items such as brownies, cakes and muffins while preserving its simple-ingredient, small-town premium positioning.

competitors.name: Traditional grocers / multicultural specialty competitors
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported multicultural grocery demand is rising as shoppers seek global flavors, transparency, sourcing and fresh offerings. Experts said private label can help traditional grocers move beyond generic ethnic aisles, while specialty chains such as H-Mart, T&T, 99 Ranch and Hispanic-focused formats are expanding or experimenting with formats.

trends.topic: Mainstream CPG adapting legacy brands for dietary need states
trends.magnitude: Kraft Heinz cited lactose-free, gluten-free, plant-based, extra-protein, clean-label and no-artificial-color extensions across major brands
trends.context: Large CPG players are treating dietary access and cleaner labels as a route back to growth. Real Dough should keep any premium/sourdough claims paired with clear diet, ingredient and processing information for retailer and shopper comparison.

trends.magnitude: Tate's grew 2.5x faster than the sweet cookie category in 2025 while holding about 2% of an $11.2B market
trends.context: Simple-ingredient, bake-shop credibility is scaling inside major CPG portfolios. The signal is relevant to artisan frozen pizza: premium cues need to remain specific and credible as distribution grows.

trends.topic: Global flavors moving from specialty stores into mainstream assortment strategy
trends.magnitude: Grocery Dive cited expansion by H-Mart, T&T, 99 Ranch and Hispanic-focused formats, plus private-label opportunity for traditional grocers
trends.context: Retailers are looking for localized, authentic assortment rather than catch-all ethnic sections. Premium frozen pizza innovation may face more demand for credible global flavor formats and community-relevant assortments.

breaking.headline: Kraft Heinz focuses innovation to address ‘unmet’ consumer diet needs
breaking.summary: Kraft Heinz is using major legacy brands to enter lactose-free, gluten-free, plant-based, protein and clean-label need states.

breaking.headline: Mondelēz takes big bite of premium cookie market with Tate’s
breaking.summary: Mondelēz is positioning Tate's as a premium, simple-ingredient growth platform with potential to expand beyond cookies.

breaking.headline: Multicultural grocery demand is rising. Here’s what grocers can do.
breaking.summary: Grocery Dive reported rising demand for global flavors, localized assortments and private-label multicultural products.
